comment: Optional dependencies for the local model tests in
tests/vector_search/local-rag.test.js. These are not in package.json
because gpt4all requires node-gyp native compilation, which is slow and
fragile to install on the CI runner. The tests that need them are opt-in
through RUN_LOCAL_MODEL_TESTS, so CI never installs these. The ollama
package is a pure JavaScript client for the Ollama server, which must be
running locally with the voyage-4-nano model pulled.
